hints.title: Repeated Rightward Search Obstacle
hints.text: Searching for the next greater element by scanning to the right for each query independently takes quadratic time. How can a single pass over the reference array resolve the rightward successor for all elements at once?

hints.title: Monotonic Decreasing Successor Invariant
hints.text: Maintain a decreasing sequence of elements while traversing nums2. Whenever a larger incoming value appears, it is the next greater element for all smaller preceding values in the sequence.

hints.title: Mapping Successor Resolution Procedure
hints.text: Iterate through nums2 with a list of unresolved elements and an answer map. While the list is non-empty and nums2[i] > list[-1], map list.pop() to nums2[i]. Append nums2[i]. Map any remaining values in the list to -1. Finally, map each query in nums1 to its precomputed answer.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass over nums2 resolving next greater element into a lookup table followed by O(1) query lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning nums2 for each of the N1 elements in nums1 takes O(N1 * N2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing answers in an auxiliary lookup table bounds total operations to linear O(N1 + N2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizing standard next greater element pattern and using a dictionary for instant query lookup.
